related.title: PsiQuantum Omega 融合式光子架構
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼；PsiQuantum Omega 融合式光子架構改以光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding; PsiQuantum Omega fusion-based photonic architecture centers on sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照光子與時間模式與單光子編碼，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到PsiQuantum Omega 融合式光子架構，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以跨機架回饋期限為起點，設計一項能區分「光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼」與「光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare photons and time modes with single-photon encoding and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to PsiQuantum Omega fusion-based photonic architecture, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from interrack feedforward deadlines and propose an observation distinguishing sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding from sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules, including uncertainty.

related.title: Google Willow 表面碼系統

related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.

practice: 對照光子與時間模式與Willow 非諧能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google Willow 表面碼系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以跨機架回饋期限為起點，設計一項能區分「光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼」與「碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare photons and time modes with willow anharmonic levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google Willow surface-code system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from interrack feedforward deadlines and propose an observation distinguishing sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding from code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, including uncertainty.

history.title: Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統
history.titleEn: Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system
history.text: Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統的公開資料展示光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system illustrate sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
